mechanics.name: Calm Spirit
mechanics.currentEffect: You do not scare Crows or scream. You Bless and Cleanse Totems and unlock Chests silently and 8/9/10% faster.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Replaced the 40/35/30% interaction slowdown with an 8/9/10% speed bonus for silent Blessing, Cleansing, and Chest Unlocking; Crow and scream suppression remain.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Suppresses Crow alerts and screams, and makes Totem and Chest interactions silent and faster.
duration: The Crow and scream suppression is passive; the interaction bonus applies while Blessing, Cleansing, or unlocking a Chest.
specialInteractions: Blessing, Cleansing, and Chest Unlocking are silent while affected by Calm Spirit.

editorial.summary: Never scream or scare Crows, and perform silent Totem and Chest interactions up to 10% faster instead of slower.
useCases: Hard-counter Killer perks and powers that rely on Survivor screams for information.
Move near Crows with much lower risk of creating a visible disturbance.
Interact with chests or Totems silently when stealth matters more than speed.
counters: Provides little value in matches without meaningful scream or Crow interactions.
The side-objective speed bonus is small and does not make Chests or Totems efficient by itself.
pros: Complete scream suppression is a genuine hard counter.
cons: Matchup-dependent against Killers and perks that do not use screams or Crows.
Its 8/9/10% interaction-speed bonus is useful but modest.
analysis: Calm Spirit received a simple but important repair in 10.2: the old interaction-speed penalty is gone. Totem blessing/cleansing and Chest unlocking are now silent and up to 10% faster instead of up to 30% slower.
That removes the worst feeling attached to the perk. Scream immunity is still matchup-dependent, but you no longer pay a universal side-objective tax just for bringing the counter.
Against scream-heavy Killers and information perks, complete scream suppression can deny valuable tracking. Crow immunity remains a smaller but occasionally useful environmental benefit.
The buff does not make Calm Spirit universal, but it raises the floor enough that its old near-bottom ranking is no longer appropriate without review.
editorial.verdict: No longer punishes you for equipping it. Calm Spirit is still a matchup counter, but 10.2 turned its silent side interactions from a tax into a small bonus.
